profiles.name: Botswana
profiles.summary: A big, quiet country where the safari is the point: water in the north, salt and sand in the middle.
profiles.description:
Botswana keeps its visitor numbers low on purpose.

Most trips pair the Okavango Delta with Chobe.
profiles.bestTimeToVisit: May to October, the dry season
profiles.heroCredit: Photo by Rory Ashman on Unsplash

profiles.name: Chobe National Park
profiles.tagline: The largest elephant herds in Africa
profiles.summary: Chobe is best seen from the river, where herds come down to drink in the late afternoon.
profiles.description:
The Chobe River forms the park's northern edge.

Boat safaris get closer than a vehicle can.
profiles.heroAlt: A herd of elephants drinking at the Chobe River
profiles.heroCredit: Photo by Rory Ashman on Unsplash

attractions.name: River safari
attractions.summary: A boat trip along the Chobe at sunset.
attractions.photoAlt: A boat on the Chobe River
attractions.photoCredit: Photo by A. Photographer on Unsplash

profiles.name: Okavango Delta
profiles.tagline: A river that ends in the desert
profiles.summary: The delta floods in the dry season, so the best game viewing is when everything else is parched.
profiles.heroAlt: Aerial view of the Okavango river
profiles.heroCredit: Photo by Wynand Uys on Unsplash

attractions.name: Mokoro trip
attractions.summary: Glide through the channels in a dugout canoe.

profiles.name: Giza
profiles.summary: The only one of the ancient wonders still standing, on the edge of Cairo.
profiles.heroAlt: The pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx
profiles.heroCredit: Photo by Dilip Poddar on Unsplash

attractions.name: The Great Pyramid
attractions.summary: Built for Khufu about 4,500 years ago.

masai-mara.summary: Open savanna in southwest Kenya, and the place to see the wildebeest river crossings.
masai-mara.description: The reserve is best known for the migration, between July and October.
